about: Local corrections applied on top of OSM by scripts/build_resort.py for Isola 2000. Rule (as for Saint-Lary): where OSM and the official resort data disagree, the official data wins; names follow the official piste map. Evidence and open questions: docs/official-comparison.md (Isola 2000 section).
officialSources: https://isola2000.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/guide-pratique-hiver-web.pdf (Guide pratique hiver 2025/2026, p. 4–5 'Plan des pistes' with vector labels, p. 6 counts: 45 pistes, 20 lifts; read 2026-10-29)
https://tiles.openskimap.org/geojson/runs.geojson + lifts.geojson (OpenSkiMap export of 2026-10-28; Isola extract kept in data/isola/raw/openskimap-*.geojson)

acceptNearGaps.why: Same rule as Saint-Lary: piste ends that miss the next piste by at most 30 m are treated as connected.

looseEndRadiusWhy: Chevrette stops mid-slope in OSM (2095 m, past the Combe Grosse crossing) with nothing within 200 m below it. With 500 m the build connects it to Sierra at the same altitude, which then continues down; the connection is an estimate.
